annotations.title: Get the Stellar transaction to sign

description: When an order shows sign_stellar_onboarding, build the one transaction the receiving address must sign (creates the account if needed, adds the USDC trustline, claims the USDC, delivers XLM). Returns signingRequestId, the unsigned XDR, networkPassphrase, a readable operations list and expiresAt (at most 5 minutes). Sign it with the receiver wallet YOU control (Stellar SDK, Freighter, any wallet); do not modify it. Check the operations first, and decode the XDR locally to confirm it matches them exactly. The transaction source must NOT be your address (it is a ROZO channel account, so ROZO pays the network fee). Allowed, nothing else: ROZO-sourced beginSponsoringFutureReserves and createAccount for your address; from your address, changeTrust for USDC (issuer GA5ZSEJYB37JRC5AVCIA5MOP4RHTM335X2KGX3IHOJAPP5RE34K4KZVN), endSponsoringFutureReserves, claimClaimableBalance, and at most one payment: the sponsor fee in USDC to ROZO claim custody GBLTI2TTQXUAYNKGCQ63YA55KTFEAOQJ3DPBPELNPWCJVE76ADWMXUAE; and a ROZO-sourced XLM payment to your address. Any other operation type or source (setOptions, extra payments): refuse. Amounts: the claimed USDC (gross) equals the current stable leg minimumAmount (order.legs, after repricing) plus the sponsor fee; the sponsor fee is fixed at quote time (0.0000001 USDC with a paid usdGas tier, the quoted stellar_sponsor_fee with usdGas "0", no fee payment if the address needed no onboarding); the XLM payment equals the native (XLM) leg minimumAmount. The XDR shows only the claimable balance id; its amount is in the operations list and on Horizon /claimable_balances/{id}. The hash of the locally decoded transaction (tx.hash() as hex) must equal the txHash of this signing request. Every ROZO-sourced operation and the transaction source must be one of funding_capabilities rozoAccounts (reserveSponsor, xlmPayer, transactionSources). Do not echo fundingId into logs. Expired, or submit failed: just call this tool again; it supersedes the old request and returns a fresh XDR (only refused while a signed one is still submitting). This server never sees your key. Then call stellar_wallet_submit_signed.
